title: Reminder rows drive due soon only; compliance has none
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as an Owner/Admin or as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings, open the "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates" (if the build shows "Maintenance schedules" instead, use that entry and record the label). Schedules are shared by the whole organization, whichever location is chosen in the header.
  3. A schedule with a routine service "PM-A" (calendar Every 30 days, default reminder rows) and a compliance service "CVIP" (Term 12 months). Seed it with the standard steps.
  4. Enrol one asset on it (asset Maintenance tab > Enroll in Schedule) and enter PM-A's last service date as 20 days before today, so PM-A comes due in 10 days (20 + 10 = 30).
custom_steps:
1. On the asset's Maintenance tab read PM-A's badge, then find the same row on the worklist.
  2. Look on the schedule, on each service and in the service form for any send switch.
  3. Open the CVIP service form and look for reminder rows.
  4. Check whether any email went to the customer without anyone pressing Send reminder.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • PM-A reads "Due soon" (its 14-days-before row is reached: due in 10 days) on the asset tab and on the worklist.
  • There is no send switch on the schedule or on any service.
  • The CVIP form has no reminder rows; it shows "Remind before expiry" in their place.
  • Nothing is emailed automatically; a reminder reaches a customer only when someone presses Send reminder on the contact card.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10562 (S5, Reminder timing), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S5 (What the rows drive; Compliance is the exception); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R8: “The rows drive when a service reads due soon on the asset tab, the worklist and the panel”
  • S5-N1: “There is no send switch on the schedule or on a service”
  • S5-R11: “A compliance service has no reminder rows. Its form shows Remind before expiry, per S3-R8, in their place”
  • S5-N1: “Nothing in v1 emails a customer automatically. There is no send switch on the schedule or on a service. A reminder reaches a customer only when someone presses Send reminder on the contact card”
  • S5-E1: “Rows after the due date carry no internal effect in v1: a service is overdue from its due date onward whatever they say”
